facts.text: SAT and ACT scores aren't considered at all, even if you send them, like the rest of the University of California.
Transferring in is a real route: for fall 2024, UCLA admitted 6,177 of 27,177 transfer applicants (23%), and 93% of admitted transfers came from California community colleges.

sources.title: UCLA Admission: Transfer Profile, Fall 2024
sources.quote: of admitted transfers come from a California community college

facts.text: California residents from families earning under $100,000 who qualify for aid have UC's system-wide tuition and fees covered through the Blue and Gold Opportunity Plan; filing the FAFSA or California Dream Act Application is how you're considered.
